Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of…
Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.

people.name: Adoram
people.line: Official in charge of forced labor under David and Solomon

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.
translations.bsb: He sent them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000 men, so that they would spend one month in Lebanon and two months at home. And Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
translations.kjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
translations.asv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to taskwork.
